audit.why: Favoured lane (53.54% WR, 3123 games): Katarina's entire kit is blinks, which is exactly what Vex's passive punishes; W or a feared ability also cancels her Death Lotus channel. 4/10 difficulty fits.
Chart consistent across packet, full and content: Vex all 7 rows. Ratings 7-8 match a hard counter. No edits needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no numbers; two bleed bullets; content wants.foe[0] called Katarina's Q 'Bunny Hop' — a fabricated name (Bunny Hop is Zeri's). Her Q is Bouncing Blade.
audit.why: Kit: Shunpo 12/11/10/9/8s but her passive Voracity dramatically refunds cooldowns on takedowns; Death Lotus 75/60/45s and is a channel any CC cancels — Vex's fear interrupts it; Death Lotus also applies healing reduction. W Preparation tosses a dagger she can Shunpo to.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with Shunpo/Death Lotus numbers and the channel interrupt; fabricated Q name replaced with Bouncing Blade; bleed bullets replaced with the arrival-pulse tell and the reset-chase warning.
